scripts.check: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.fix: npm run format:fix && npm run lint:fix
scripts.sync-lockfile:frontend: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yaml run --rm frontend-preview npm install
scripts.sync-lockfile:e2e-tests: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yaml run --rm --no-deps e2e-tests npm install
scripts.sync-lockfiles: npm run sync-lockfile:frontend && npm run sync-lockfile:e2e-tests
